pages.title: Topological Wafer
pages.text: A wafer whose edges carry current without resistance, protected by topology. No scratch or defect in the middle can interrupt the flow around the rim. It looks like a thin grey disc with a faintly shimmering edge.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cutting a Topological Boule in the Planck-Scale Cutter, I worried slicing would ruin its edges. Instead every slice had its own protected boundary, because topology does not care where you cut.
Made in $(item)Planck-Scale Cutter$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Precision Lithography.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Topological Logic Wafer.
